headline: Painter's gem wasted in 1-0 loss to Diamondbacks
recap: Andrew Painter allowed just two hits over seven scoreless innings, but the Phillies fell 1-0 to the Diamondbacks on Wednesday in Phoenix. Painter struck out six and walked none and left with a no-decision after the Phillies' offense could only manage three hits against six Arizona relievers. James McCann's solo home run off reliever Jonathan Bowlan in the bottom of the eighth was the only run of the game; Bowlan took the loss. Bryan De La Cruz had two of Philadelphia's three hits, including a double. Jonathan Loáisiga worked a scoreless top of the eighth to pick up the win, and Juan Morillo closed it out in the ninth for the save.
The loss left the Phillies at 79-61, second in the NL East, four games behind the division-leading Braves, and snapped a six-game winning streak.

Philadelphia is off Thursday before opening a four-game series at home against Atlanta on Friday. Cristopher Sánchez is scheduled to start the opener against Braves left-hander Chris Sale, with first pitch set for 6:40 PM ET at Citizens Bank Park. A betting line was not yet available for the series opener.
